title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.32472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deployed machine learning models in real-world IoT and edge/cloud systems face a critical reliability bottleneck: the requirement for online adaptation to non-stationary data streams while operating without access to the full original training dataset. Performance is severely degraded when models encounter Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs or suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Addressing these challenges requires adaptation mechanisms capable of learning from evolving data streams while preserving previously acquired knowledge. This paper proposes an edge-cloud methodology for integrating Continual Learning (CL) with Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection and Concept Drift Detection in IoT applications. The methodology incorporates ODIN and ECDD as alternative mechanisms for identifying informative samples for annotation and triggering rehearsal-based model updates. translated_title: 边缘-云应用中的在线持续学习
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的物联网（IoT）及边缘/云系统中部署的机器学习模型面临一个关键的可靠性瓶颈：需要在无法访问完整原始训练数据集的情况下，对非平稳数据流进行在线适应。当模型遇到分布外（OOD）输入或遭受灾难性遗忘时，性能会严重下降。应对这些挑战需要一种适应机制，能够从不断演变的数据流中学习，同时保留先前获得的知识。本文提出了一种边缘-云方法论，用于在物联网应用中将持续学习（CL）与分布外检测及概念漂移检测相集成。该方法引入了ODIN和ECDD作为可选机制，用于识别具有信息价值的样本以进行标注，并触发基于回放的模型更新。实验结果在汽车、医疗健康和农业等数据集上……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种边缘-云方法论，将持续学习与分布外检测及概念漂移检测相集成，利用ODIN和ECDD机制识别有价值的样本并触发基于回放的模型更新，从而解决物联网应用中模型在线适应非平稳数据流时的灾难性遗忘和分布外性能退化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an edge-cloud methodology that integrates continual learning with OOD detection and concept drift detection, using ODIN and ECDD as alternative mechanisms to identify informative samples for annotation and trigger rehearsal-based model updates, thereby addressing catastrophic forgetting and OOD performance degradation when adapting models online to non-stationary data streams in IoT applications.
